## Checklist
- [ ] `python tests/run_all.py` passes (paste the summary)
- [ ] If the engine (`web/js/*`, WGSL) changed: `python tests/run_all.py --engine` passes (paste the summary), or I explain which case changes and why
- [ ] New architecture: manifest/module, generator variant, conformance output **including a mutation check**, one real-model measurement (docs/ARCH_GUIDE.md §5)
- [ ] Performance claims include hardware, driver, OS, browser and `tools/bench.py` output
- [ ] Text files only; no model files, binaries, secrets, or personal or private data
